attire.men: Dhoti, Kurta or full pants and modest shirt. Sleeveless vests not allowed in inner sanctum.
attire.women: Saree or Salwar Kameez. Dupatta/scarf recommended. Shoulders and knees must be covered.
attire.footwear: Leather items (belts, wallets, shoes) strictly prohibited inside Kashi Vishwanath temple premises. Deposit at locker.

photography: Prohibited inside inner sanctum. Strictly prohibited at Manikarnika and Harishchandra burning ghats.
customs: Ring the temple bell upon entry. Accept prasad with your right hand. Walk clockwise (pradakshina) around sanctums.
taboos: Never point feet towards the deity or holy Ganga river while sitting. Do not smoke or consume alcohol near ghats.

attire.men: Smart casual or full trousers. Respectful t-shirt/shirt.
attire.women: Long skirts, pants, or traditional Indian wear with covered shoulders.
attire.footwear: Remove footwear before entering temple courtyards, marble cenotaphs, and sacred pavilions.

photography: Allowed in courtyards. Additional fee for royal chambers. Never photograph royal portraits with flash.
customs: Greet with 'Khamma Ghani' or folded hands 'Namaste'. Show respect to elders.
taboos: Do not touch delicate frescoes or mirror work in Sheesh Mahal.

attire.men: Modest clothing covering legs. Head MUST be covered with scarf/rumal at all times.
attire.women: Modest clothing covering legs and shoulders. Head MUST be covered at all times.
attire.footwear: Deposit shoes and socks at free Jora Ghar. Wash feet in the cleansing foot-pool before entering parikrama.

photography: Allowed on the outer marble parikrama. Strictly forbidden inside the sanctum.
customs: Cover your head before stepping onto the complex. Langar (community kitchen) is free and served to all sitting equally on floor mats.
taboos: Tobacco, alcohol, and intoxication are strictly forbidden within 500m of the holy complex.

attire.men: Traditional Dhoti/Veshti or formal pants. Lungis and bermuda shorts strictly barred.
attire.women: Saree, Half-saree, or Churidar with Dupatta. Jeans, leggings, and sleeveless tops not permitted.
attire.footwear: Deposit at designated counter outside temple gopuram towers.

photography: Mobile phones and cameras completely prohibited inside temple complex by High Court order.
customs: Circumbulate in clockwise direction. Speak in hushed tones inside pillared halls.
taboos: Do not enter sanctum if consuming non-vegetarian food earlier the same day.
